st: Cryptocurrencies, the Mona Lisa, Majin Buu and inflation

sec.p: Yes, I'm a bit obsessed with cryptocurrencies. And in this 🎼ff I'll explain why.
The charts seem to show stagnation. What's changed recently? AI, ChatGPT and MidJourney. As discussed here:
In short, crypto guarantees access to ever more essential digital services, like a financial VPN.
In the very first 🎼ff, the sector's environmental impact, with Bitcoin consuming as much as Finland (🇫🇮 ff.1.5 Bitcoin's energy consumption).
What do Twitter and Elon Musk have to do with all this?

sec.t: ff.73.6 A new phase for capitalism
sec.p: The move to cryptocurrencies (and to a system of digital contracts) could be the next efficiency phase of the capitalist system, according to Not Boring by Packy McCormick.
